purpose: User-supplied dynasty watermarks adapted to a darker Nagash funerary style, preserving the original obelisk and staff silhouettes.

exports.alignment: Uniform scaling and centering to the source alpha >= 128 bounds. Existing native texture filenames are retained; these are shared Tomb Kings watermark replacements.
exports.alpha_cleanup: Dark engraved marks become transparent cut-outs. Uneven material opacity and texture are removed; transparent exterior and antialiased edges are retained. Every nontransparent pixel uses RGB (52, 48, 54).

images.prompt: Edit target: the attached Total War Warhammer III technology tree watermark. This MUST remain recognizably the same exact background asset: preserve the overall silhouette, original width-to-height ratio, main ornaments, spacing and placement. The change is confined to a few carved symbols, creating a darker, sinister death-cult aesthetic invoking NAGASH, Great Necromancer, for Arkhan the Black. At the existing upper skull engraving add a small menacing angular crown evoking Nagash, with three long skeletal spikes and a narrow elongated skull. Retain the three lower skulls, snake row, zigzag frieze and skull plinth. Turn just a few existing glyphs into sinister angular necromantic marks. Art direction: ancient funerary stencil / flat engraved UI watermark, restrained ominous charcoal with only an extremely subtle muted dark-violet undertone. All visible material should remain dark neutral charcoal about RGB 45-55, no bright accents. Transparent carved cut-outs. Clean sharp silhouette and readable tiny details. Preserve the original simple low-contrast UI background style; do not create a realistic painting, lighting, textures, gradients, bevels or ornamental frame. No colourful gold, green, blue, pink, bright purple, magical glow, text, labels or extra objects. Full object visible on transparent tall narrow portrait canvas, same relative margins as the reference. One watermark only. Genuinely transparent background.
